title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.04.3
notes:
- Community Samples is available in the Browser on Windows, Linux and Mac. Browse by sound type and genre, see waveforms, preview audio and drag samples directly into the Playlist.
- Create a community account in the app to vote and upload your own samples. Uploads require a specific sound type, genre, creator credit and acceptance of the royalty-free license. Email updates are optional.
- Saved user templates now restore their mixer FX enable and bypass states, including the master track. The factory starter keeps its original defaults.
- Switching between main menu titles opens the new menu on the first press. Edit includes Undo history even in a fresh project.
- Plugin scanning tolerates non-UTF-8 or unterminated diagnostic output from plugins. Channel Strip view now identifies tested Waves support and untested support for compatible resizable UAD strips.
- Channel Strip pages now stop at the Waves panel dividers on SSL E/G, SSL EV2 and Abbey Road TG12345. Narrow pages such as Scheps Omni Channel fit their mixer columns at smaller sizes.
- On 64-bit Windows, Settings > Plugins offers a remembered opt-in to scan compatible native FL Studio instruments and effects from your own installation. Installed copies are checked in isolation before use; compatibility varies by plugin.

https://michaellanemusic.de/lemon-studio/
